policy: Original source trees are preserved. Retain training, inference, standard evaluation, preparation, rewards, tests, and processed JSON data; share identical source files. Bundle required Motion-R1 and customized TRL dependencies with their licenses. Adapt local paths/imports and fix the requested GRPO DDP synchronization ordering; pin the compatible Transformers version. Copy Qwen, the SFT initialization checkpoint used by prior GRPO runs, reward/evaluation assets, and HumanML3D resources. Exclude standalone SMPL rendering, auxiliary physics/latent/statistical analysis, historical W&B runs, source logs/caches, and old experiment artifacts. Newly authorized training creates its own logs/checkpoints. No source links or hard links are created.
